name: Menubar
description: A horizontal bar of menu triggers whose submenus open below the bar. Rows, keyboard traversal and popup surfaces are the menu component's; MenubarTheme is owned by menu and resolved here.

fields.border: bool? - whether the bar draws its border; null = true

accessibility.keyboard: one roving tab stop for the bar: ArrowUp/Down move and wrap between triggers, Home/End jump, ArrowRight opens the focused trigger's submenu, ArrowLeft closes the open submenu, Escape closes a level, typing selects a trigger by prefix
accessibility.semantics: triggers are menu buttons through the menu rows; disabled rows dim to 50% opacity

notes: MenubarState (the old public state class that drifted from the menu copy) is deleted; Menubar is a stateless container and RovingGroup owns traversal.
The bar lays the top-level group out in a stretched Row while keeping Axis.vertical as the group direction, so popups opened from the bar lay out as columns.
ArrowUp/Down traverse the bar and ArrowRight opens a submenu: the accepted menu traversal engine is used unchanged (no menubar-specific key handling).
The old menu/menubar-specific button rows are gone; bar triggers look like menu rows.
